E9_monotone_lock.mechanism: the lock file is NEVER unlinked. Content transitions held -> releasing -> released, each an in-place write plus file fsync — no namespace change, so no directory fsync can strand it. Entry is legal ONLY over the exact durable content 'released'; the reclaim transition is elected by its own O_EXCL lock.
E9_monotone_lock.invariant: at every injected boundary either the old lock remains authoritative or a durable released state exists; no failure leaves an absent, unacknowledged lock.

E10_per_identity_freshness.mechanism: each verdict carries ITS OWN venue event time, preferring the stamp field the venue dedicates to the declared status (canceled_at/expired_at/filled_at); contradictory status/stamp combinations refuse. The executor judges freshness PER REQUESTED IDENTITY, drops stale verdicts into a journaled dropped_stale, and the gate blocks naming the identity.
